We are no longer accepting new applications for Fall 2026 admission to our graduate programs at William & Mary's Batten School of Coastal & Marine Sciences, located at the Virginia Institute of Marine Science (VIMS). Applications for Fall 2027 entry will open August 1, 2026.
Prospective students may apply to one of our three graduate marine science degree programs:
Master of Arts (M.A.) in Marine Science
Master of Science (M.S.) in Marine Science
Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.) in Marine Science
Key Dates
August 1, 2026 - Application opens
December 1, 2026 - Deadline for submission of the online application, this includes:
Unofficial transcripts from all colleges and universities attended
All three letters of recommendation from your references
Responses to the required block questions
Resume or CV
The online payment of the $44 (US) non-refundable application fee. The application is not complete until the fee has been paid or waived.
No late applications are accepted.
December 4, 2026 - Application review by faculty begins
April 1, 2027 - Latest date for notification of admission
Single column table for formatting purposes
Application Components
Carefully read this Application Instructions document.
Prior to matriculation, M.S. or M.A. applicants must complete a Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution, and Ph.D. applicants must complete a Master's degree from an accredited institution. Students interested in pursuing our M.S. to Ph.D. bypass track need only to have completed a Bachelor's degree.
There is no minimum GPA requirement for admission to the Batten School of Coastal & Marine Sciences, however, most successful applicants have a GPA of 3.0 or better on a 4.0 scale.
Unofficial transcripts uploaded for all completed course work (official transcripts will be required if you are accepted to the program)
Resumé or CV
Block question responses
Three letters of recommendation
Non-refundable application fee of $44 (US). The application is not complete until the fee has been paid or waived.
GRE Scores
GRE scores are not required for admission to the Batten School of Coastal & Marine Sciences. They are not used by the Admission Committee nor the Office for Academic Affairs to evaluate or rank applicants, and cannot be submitted through the application website. Individual faculty members may wish to see unofficial GRE scores, but they will not be shared with the Admissions Committee or other faculty members. We recommend that applicants for the M.S. or Ph.D. programs contact prospective faculty advisors to inquire if they wish to see GRE scores. Applicants for the M.A. program do not need to submit unofficial GRE scores to the M.A. Program Director.
M.S. & Ph.D. Applicants Only
As you apply, please review descriptions of the research programs of our faculty and contact faculty members with whom you share research interests. Discuss with them specific research areas, funding opportunities, and program information. You will be required to name prospective advisor(s) as part of your application.
